info.text:
About 7 million U.S. adults have no credit record and 25 million more have no score. This guide walks through building credit from zero, step by step: checking your free reports, the four starter tools (secured cards, credit-builder loans, authorized user, student cards), using a card so it helps instead of hurts, and the real timeline to a FICO score. Worked examples show utilization and interest math, plus the mistakes that set you back.

Sources: FICO Score Credit Insights report (Aug 25, 2026); FICO average score reports (2017-2025); CFPB credit invisibles update (June 2025); CFPB credit-builder loan research (2020); myFICO scoring criteria; FTC on free weekly credit reports (Oct 2023); Credit CARD Act of 2009; Federal Reserve G.19 (Q2 2026).

News and education, not financial advice.
